article.story: Prairie View A&M Panthers (2-2) at Vanderbilt Commodores (3-0) Nashville, Tennessee; Friday, 7 p.m. EST LINE: Commodores -40.5; over/under is 152.5 BOTTOM LINE: No. 22 Vanderbilt hosts Prairie View A&M after Aaron Glass scored 23 points in Vanderbilt's 105-81 win over the Memphis Tigers. Vanderbilt finished 27-9 overall a season ago while going 13-3 at home. The Commodores averaged 16.8 points off of turnovers, 11.6 second-chance points and 19.8 bench points last season. Prairie View A&M finished 3-13 on the road and 19-18 overall a season ago. The Panthers allowed opponents to score 76.5 points per game and shot 44.1% from the field last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
